enriched.title: Past Continuous e Vocabulário de Situações Cotidianas
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do tempo verbal Past Continuous com exemplos práticos do cotidiano, além de introduzir vocabulário relevante e expressões úteis. Também inclui estrutura gramatical e frases para prática de pronúncia.

vocabulary.definition: To say no to an offer, request, or invitation.
examples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East.

vocabulary.definition: To assure someone that you will definitely do something.
examples: Trump promised that he will end the war in Ukraine.

vocabulary.definition: To move forward or advance in development.
examples: Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer.

vocabulary.definition: The process of planning how to spend money.
examples: Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company?

vocabulary.definition: To stop working permanently, usually due to age.
examples: What are you going to do when you retire?

grammar.explanation: The Past Continuous is used to describe actions that were ongoing in the past.
rules: Used for background actions interrupted by another event in the past.
examples: While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company?
He met his wife when he was working in Japan.
commonMistakes: Using 'was' with plural subjects (e.g., 'They was working' instead of 'They were working').
Forgetting to add '-ing' to the verb (e.g., 'She was wear a coat' instead of 'She was wearing a coat').

expressions.usage: Used to express enjoyment during an event or activity.
examples: Did you have fun / have a good time in Vancouver?

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: While I ______ (shop) for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The action of shopping was ongoing in the past, so the Past Continuous is used.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'Ele conheceu sua esposa quando ele estava trabalhando no Japão.'
practiceQuestions.answer: He met his wife when he was working in Japan.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence combines the Simple Past ('met') and the Past Continuous ('was working') to describe a completed action happening during an ongoing situation.

culturalNotes: Stand-up comedy is a popular form of entertainment in the United States and many English-speaking countries.
The use of AI in medicine is a growing trend globally, with advancements in diagnostics and treatments.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences in the Past Continuous by describing past activities you did yesterday.
Listen to native speakers using Past Continuous in context, such as in podcasts or TV shows, to improve your understanding.
originalExamples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East. (O comediante de stand-up recusou a oferta de um milhão de dólares para participar de um festival no Oriente Médio.)
Trump promised that he will end the war in Ukraine. (Trump prometeu que ele acabará com a guerra na Ucrânia.)
Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer. (A medicina progredirá mais rapidamente com a ajuda da IA, especialmente no tratamento do câncer.)
While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo compras para o Natal, eu também comprei algumas coisas para mim.)
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company? (Seu departamento estava fazendo o orçamento do próximo ano quando o Diretor deixou a empresa?)
He met his wife when he was working in Japan. (Ele conheceu sua esposa quando ele estava trabalhando no Japão.)
Did you have fun / have a good time in Vancouver? (Vocês se divertiram em Vancouver?)
Was she wearing a coat when she left? (Ela estava usando um casaco quando ela saiu?)
When will we colonize Mars? (Quando colonizaremos Marte?)
What are you going to do when you retire? (O que você vai fazer quando aposentar-se?)
Were you driving at high speed when the police stopped you? (Você estava dirigindo a alta velocidade quando a polícia o parou?)
I met Tom and Jane at the airport some weeks ago. (Encontrei Tom e Jane no aeroporto algumas semanas atrás.)
They were going to Paris. (Eles estavam indo para Paris.)
We talked while we were waiting for our flights. (Nós conversamos enquanto esperávamos por nossos vôos.)
